in_sanskrit.name: हसम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Hasam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'हस' (hasa), which means 'laughter, merriment, joy'. The suffix 'म' (ma) is added to the root word to form the noun 'हसम' (hasam), which can be translated as 'the cause of laughter' or 'the embodiment of joy'.

in_hindi.name: हसम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Hasam in Hindi is written as 'हसम'. Its meaning can be translated as 'one who desires to laugh, one who is extremely happy'. This name is rarely used in India and is not associated with any famous personalities.

in_tamil.name: ஹசம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil transcription of the name Hasam is 'ஹசம்'. Its meaning can be translated as 'one who does not have happiness, joy or merriment'. This is an unusual and uncommon interpretation of the name.

in_telugu.name: హేశం
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Hasam in Telugu is written as 'హేశం'. Its meaning can be translated as 'Lord of happiness, joy, or merriment'. The name is rarely used in Andhra Pradesh or Telangana and is not associated with any famous personalities.
